text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Kikuka Sho, and the paddock is extremely lively.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower has undergone a major transformation over the course of just one summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While there is concern that the long distance will be difficult for her… Mihono Bourbon is still the favorite to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Matikanetannhauser is very excited for the race, even if there aren't many eyes on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho, the race to decide the strongest Umamusume, begins!
